conventions.line: E[H] = (total - spread)/2 with spread in betting convention (home -6.5 = favoured)
conventions.rho_segK: OLS slope of dm over segment K on m at its start, controlling for -spread
conventions.rho_pooled: pooled over segments 2-8: dm on [lead vs line L_k, e*k/8, e]; rho = coef on L_k
conventions.rho_pooled_pull_to_zero_coef: coef on e*k/8: = rho if the pull is toward a 0 margin, 0 if toward the line's path
conventions.rhoT_segK: OLS slope of the total's change over segment K on the running total at its start, controlling for the total line
conventions.var_team_given_poss_line: residual var of team points on [1, own possessions, line E[team]]
conventions.leader_dm_vs_line: leader's dm over the next segment minus line drift (e/8), by |m| at start
conventions.b4: OLS slope of final margin (incl. OT) on m3, controlling for -spread
conventions.q4_pace_ratio: Q4 possessions / mean Q1-Q3 quarter possessions
conventions.q4_leader_net100: 100 x (leader PPP - trailer PPP) in Q4; exp = line-implied net/100
conventions.ppp: points per possession, counting method of pbp._mark_possessions
conventions.reb: outcome of missed FGs / missed final FTs: player or team, off or def; none = no rebound logged
